subtasks.title: Missed-Op Invalid disposition removes its row (null-guarded rowKey on changeDisposition)
subtasks.approach: In resources/views/components/scans/disposition-popup.blade.php, changeDisposition(value): the non-reason branch currently calls window.updateScanDisposition(this.modelId, value) with no rowKey (line ~90). Change that single call to pass reason 'other' in the 3rd slot and a rowKey in the 4th slot ONLY when (this.missedOpportunity === true && value === DispositionEnum::INVALID->value ('Invalid')); otherwise pass null. rowKey = 'scan-' + (this.rowLoop?.index ?? this.modelId), null-guarded to mirror the server-side anchor id ($rowLoop?->index ?? $model_id) and avoid a TypeError in cluster-group views that pass no rowLoop. This reuses the existing app.js `if (rowKey)` removal branch — no app.js change. Because the gate is missedOpportunity+INVALID, Scans/Hits dropdown picks and the INVALID_SCAN reason-button path (line 215) are entirely unaffected.
subtasks.intended_diffs:
changeDisposition(value): replace `window.updateScanDisposition(this.modelId, value);` with:
  window.updateScanDisposition(
      this.modelId,
      value,
      'other',
      (this.missedOpportunity && value === '{{ \App\Enums\DispositionEnum::INVALID->value }}')
          ? 'scan-' + (this.rowLoop?.index ?? this.modelId)
          : null
  );
Leave the INVALID_SCAN branch (showReasons / advance-close) and the reason-button call at line ~215 untouched.
